jobs.description: SUMMARY Wissen Technology is hiring for IT Recruiter About Wissen Technology: At Wissen Technology, we deliver niche, custom-built products that solve complex business challenges across industries worldwide. Founded in 2015, our core philosophy is built around a strong product engineering mindset ensuring every solution is architected and delivered right the first time. Today, Wissen Technology has a global footprint with 2000+ employees across offices in the US, UK, UAE, India, and Australia. Our commitment to excellence translates into delivering 2X impact compared to traditional service providers. How do we achieve this? Through a combination of deep domain knowledge, cutting - edge technology expertise, and a relentless focus on quality. We don’t just meet expectations we exceed them by ensuring faster time-to-market, reduced rework, and greater alignment with client objectives. We have a proven track record of building mission-critical systems across industries, including financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and more. Wissen stands apart through its unique delivery models. Our outcome-based projects ensure predictable costs and timelines, while our agile pods provide clients the flexibility to adapt to their evolving business needs. Wissen leverages its thought leadership and technology prowess to drive superior business outcomes. Our success is powered by top-tier talent. Our mission is clear: to be the partner of choice for building world-class custom products that deliver exceptional impact the first time, every time. Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated IT Recruiter to join our team and manage the recruitment process for a variety of IT roles. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and selecting qualified candidates for technical positions, working closely with hiring managers to meet staffing needs and contributing to our company’s overall growth and success. Experience: 2-3 Years Location: Bangalore Mumbai Pune Mode of Work: Hybrid Key Responsibilities: Sourcing Candidates: Utilize multiple sourcing methods (job boards, social media, networking, etc.) to identify and attract top IT talent. Screening & Interviewing: Review resumes, conduct interviews, and assess candidate qualifications to ensure they align with job requirements. Job Postings: Create and manage job postings for various IT positions, ensuring they are well-written and aligned with company branding. Candidate Management: Maintain and manage candidate pipelines for current and future job openings, ensuring timely communication throughout the hiring process. Collaboration: Partner with hiring managers to understand their specific needs and work together to create comprehensive job descriptions and candidate profiles. Offer Management: Extend job offers and manage the negotiation process, ensuring competitive compensation packages. Market Research: Stay updated on industry trends and salary benchmarks to provide valuable insights to both candidates and hiring managers. Employer Branding: Assist in promoting the company as an employer of choice within the IT industry. Required Skills and Qualification: Proven experience as an IT recruiter or in a similar recruitment role, ideally in the tech industry. Familiarity with various sourcing techniques, including LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and social media platforms. Strong understanding of IT roles, technologies, and technical jargon. Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet hiring targets. Attention to detail with a focus on accuracy. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Strong organizational and time-management abilities. Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented environment. jobs.title: Fullstack Developer
jobs.description: About Us Exotel is the emerging markets leading full-stack customer engagement platform and business-focused virtual telecom operator. Founded in 2011, our cloud-based product suite powers over 50 million daily engagements across voice, video, and messaging channels. Trusted by 6,000+ companies across 60+ countriesincluding India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa—Exotel enables unified customer engagement for leading businesses such as Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, GoJek, Byju’s, HDFC Bank, Zomato, and Urban Company. Our offerings include communication APIs, a modern omnichannel contact center, and a conversational AI platform hosted on the cloud. We are a Series D company valued at $100 million with $60 million in ARR. Level: L1 @Professional Services The Professional Services team is the "Special Forces" of our engineering organization. We don't just build products; we solve high-stakes enterprise puzzles. Our engineering solves infrastructure-level problems to ensure no one misses a call or an SMS, even in highly customized enterprise environments. We focus on building fault-tolerant, scalable, and real-time distributed systems that integrate seamlessly with complex enterprise ecosystems. Our stack is diverse—built on PHP, Python, Golang, and Node.js—and we emphasize clean abstractions and loosely coupled services. We leverage MySQL, NoSQL stores, Elasticsearch for discovery, and Grafana/Kibana for deep observability. We are firm believers in "You build it, you own it!"—operating a distributed system in a customization-heavy environment requires a true DevOps mindset. Roles & Responsibilities: As a Integration and Customization Engineer - 1, in the Professional Services team, you will be the technical anchor for complex ECC (Enterprise Contact Center) project customizations. Your role is a blend of deep engineering, architectural solutioning, and high-impact delivery. Engineering Excellence: Design and develop high-complexity customizations, integrations, and automation modules for large-scale enterprise customers. Technical Leadership: Independently deliver complex modules and take ownership of the end-to-end execution of internal projects. Mentorship: Guide and unblock L1 engineers, ensuring the team maintains high coding standards and best practices. System Ownership: Navigate and optimize forked, legacy, or complex codebases to ensure high performance and reliability. Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Infosec, and Customer-facing teams to translate enterprise requirements into executable technical roadmaps. Quality Assurance: Ensure uncompromising quality through rigorous code reviews, comprehensive test plans, and flawless deployment execution. Operational Health: Track and report engineering health metrics, ensuring that production incidents are minimized and resolution is swift. Must-haves 1–2 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science. Advanced proficiency in PHP and expert knowledge of HTML, CSS, and React.JS Deep mastery of Data Structures, Algorithms (DSA), Concurrency, and Multithreading. Practical experience with 3-Tier and Microservices architectures, RESTful services, and HTTP protocols. Expert in SQL/NoSQL data modeling, caching layers, and building/deploying Linux-based applications. Understanding of TCP/IP networks and Linux OS configuration. A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex delivery cycles and production quality. Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while handling the maturity required for enterprise stakeholder interaction. General Skills Ability to translate deep technical hurdles into clear, actionable roadmaps for Product, Infosec, and enterprise clients. Mastery of the SDLC and project management tools like Jira/Confluence to ensure transparency and timeline alignment. Strong capability in creating technical diagrams, flowcharts, and project scope documents to maintain system clarity. Leadership: Proactive in unblocking peers and collaborating across cross-functional units (Development, Vendors, Partners). Good-to-haves Experience with GenAI technologies and their practical applications in enterprise workflows. Familiarity with visualization tools like Grafana and Kibana. Experience with cloud deployments (AWS/GCP/Azure) and a strong affinity for DevOps culture. Experience working in customization-heavy environments or managing "forked" codebases. What differentiates a successful candidate? The Average Candidate: Can write code to a specification but struggles when the documentation is missing, or the codebase is "messy." The A-Player: Sees a complex legacy codebase as a challenge to be mastered. They don't just fix bugs; they refactor for scale, mentor those around them, and anticipate enterprise needs before they become bottlenecks. They possess the technical depth to code and the maturity to navigate a high-pressure production environment. What success looks like (first 90 days) In this role, success is measured by your ability to move from code fluency to system-ownership. We expect high-impact contributions in two key areas: End-to-End Ownership of Complexity: Within 90 days, you will have taken full responsibility for the design, implementation, and production stabilization of a high-complexity enterprise customization. You aren't just writing code; you are operating with a "you build it, you own it" mindset, ensuring that your modules are fault-tolerant, scalable, and meet all engineering health metrics. Technical Leadership & Unblocking: You will be a recognized technical anchor who independently identifies and resolves architectural challenges within legacy or forked codebases. Success means you are effectively guiding L1 engineers through rigorous code reviews and test plans, while confidently managing technical trade-offs in discussions with enterprise stakeholders. 1-5 Yrs Python, Node.js, Full Stack, Java, PHP, Development, Fullstack Development, React.js

jobs.title: Automation Engineer - DERMS
jobs.description: ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient. Our employees passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion - and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations - we invite you to join us! ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Global Support Engineer - DERMSSolutions Location: New Delhi, India We are building ETAPs Global Support Group - a globally distributed, domain-specialized support organization designed to be the technical backbone behind ETAPs real-time control and automation systems deployed worldwide. This is not a project execution role. It is something different, and for the right person, more interesting. As a Global Support Engineer for DERMS Global Solutions, you will be ETAPs first line of technical support for intelligent load shedding and generation control systems across global clients - utilities, industrial facilities, generation plants, and critical infrastructure operators in the US, Latin America, the Middle East, Europe, India, Asia Pacific and Australia. Where project execution means delivering one system at a time, this role means your work supports every customer running these solutions, everywhere. Your core domain is ETAPs real-time automation and control suite: Intelligent Load Shedding (ILS) and Automatic Generation Control (AGC). These are your specialty, and you will own them with depth. You will also provide broader support across the DERMS solution portfolio, including microgrid and power plant control systems where global support coverage is needed. You will work through a structured ticket system, coordinating with global technical leads and regional teams, anchoring DERMS support out of India. If you have built your technical depth delivering these systems in the field and want to take it global, this is that role. Responsibilities - You will do: Own and resolve Level 1 support tickets for ETAP real-time automation and control solutions globally - with Intelligent Load Shedding (ILS) and Automatic Generation Control (AGC) as your core domain - through Jira, with a target 24-hour response and resolution discipline on standard incidents. Perform systematic first-line diagnosis: reproduce the reported issue, isolate the root cause, determine whether it is configuration, integration, or product-level, and resolve or route accordingly before any escalation. Troubleshoot ILS schemes including load preservation, load restoration, and load shedding validation logic, as well as AGC functions including load frequency control, area control error, and generator power sharing behavior. Provide broader DERMS portfolio support, including microgrid (uGrid) and power plant control fundamentals, to maintain global support coverage across the solution family. Communicate resolution, root cause, and next steps clearly and professionally to global clients and regional teams - in English, in writing, without ambiguity. Maintain and expand the Global Support knowledge base by documenting recurring issues, confirmed root causes, resolutions, and workarounds for reuse across the team. Provide complete pre-diagnosis before escalating to Level 2 - cases that reach the next level must arrive with a clear incident summary, reproduction steps, findings, and your assessment of what the issue is and is not. Coordinate with Global Support leadership on ticket queue priorities, status visibility, and escalation decisions. Requirements - You need to have: Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher) - this is a global role and the vast majority of support interactions are in English with clients across the US, Middle East, Latin America, Europe, India, Asia Pacific and Australia. Written English quality directly reflects on ETAPs support standard. Demonstrated hands-on competency delivering or supporting ETAP Intelligent Load Shedding (ILS) and Automatic Generation Control (AGC) projects - you must be able to troubleshoot these systems independently from day one without relying on escalation for standard incidents. Working familiarity with the underlying real-time platform - eSCADA and PSMS - sufficient to understand how ILS and AGC solutions are built on top of them and to navigate the monitoring and control environment confidently. Deep SME-level mastery of eSCADA and PSMS is not required. Prior ETAP project execution or technical support experience in a client-facing context - you understand how these systems are deployed, configured, commissioned, and operated in the field. Systematic and methodical troubleshooting mindset - you can reproduce a reported issue, isolate the failure point, document your findings clearly, and communicate them without being guided step by step. Strong written communication skills - every ticket update, client response, and escalation summary must be accurate, professional, and complete. Ability to manage multiple concurrent support cases across different clients, priorities, and time zones without losing ownership or follow-through on any of them. A Plus to have: Exposure to ETAP uGrid (Microgrid Controller) or Power Plant Controller (PPC) - conceptual or practical understanding of grid-tied and islanded operation, DER integration, and how microgrid and plant control interact with load shedding and generation control functions. Hands-on experience with industrial communication protocols - DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61850 - at a troubleshooting level, not just conceptual. Experience using Jira or comparable ticketing platforms for support workflow management. Background in utility, generation, or industrial environments where real-time power management and control systems are actively deployed and operated. ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary Meet the Team The Cisco cnBNG Control Plane team builds Ciscos cloud-native Broadband Network Gateway - the carrier-grade subscriber-management brain that runs as microservices on the SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) / Kubernetes platform and interworks with IOS-XR, Silicon One-based User Plane Functions (UPFs). We power some of the worlds largest residential and business broadband deployments, serving millions of subscribers with strict availability and scale requirements. We value technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices. Your Impact As a Software Engineer on the cnBNG Control Plane, you will own the design, delivery, and end-to-end quality of carrier-grade subscriber-management features in a cloud-native architecture. You will build session-handling, CP-UP separation, redundancy, and scale capabilities that keep millions of subscribers online across Silicon One-based UPFs - and own their unit, integration, system, and scale validation with automation-first practices. You will mentor junior engineers and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging. What You Will Do Design, develop, and maintain cnBNG Control Plane microservices (C/C++/Go) on the SMI/Kubernetes platform, interworking with IOS-XR / Silicon One-based User Plane Functions. Implement and enhance subscriber-management functionality: PPPoE/IPoE session bring-up, DHCPv4/DHCPv6 (server/proxy/relay), Prefix Delegation, RADIUS/AAA, PAP/CHAP, accounting, Change of Authorization, IPAM, subscriber policy, and QoS. Develop and harden CP-UP separation over the State Control Interface - session programming, state download/replay, and reconciliation between the Control Plane and Silicon One UPFs. Build features for scale and high availability: cluster upscale, N:M and geo/warm redundancy (SRG), CP-GR switchover, and subscriber-session continuity during CP-UP communication failures. Own quality end-to-end: write unit tests and component/integration tests; design and execute system, regression, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability tests for your features. Develop reusable, scalable test automation (Python; pyATS/Genie or equivalent) and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. Build and maintain containerized / virtual / cloud-based test environments (Docker, Kubernetes, SMI) and validate subscriber-scale, traffic, failover, upgrade/rollback, process-restart, and subscriber-churn scenarios. Optimize control-plane performance, memory, and convergence for millions of subscribers across large UPF fleets. Develop and maintain gRPC/REST APIs and YANG/OpenConfig models, plus CLI and model-driven telemetry for configuration and operational visibility. Troubleshoot complex, distributed issues across CP, Silicon One UPFs, and the SMI/Kubernetes stack; drive RCA using logs, traces, core dumps, RADIUS transactions, and telemetry. Manage code with Git; participate in code reviews; collaborate with Test Engineering on feature, scale, and HA validation. Work with architects, DE/DT leads, and PLM to deliver features across the release lifecycle (BC/CC, AC/EC, DEVELOPING, FCS). Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for code generation, unit/automation test creation, static analysis, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation - validating AI-generated output responsibly. Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have) Bachelors or masters degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field. Experience in systems/embedded or cloud-native software engineering for networking products. Strong programming in C/C++ and/or Go on Linux; Python for test automation and scripting. Hands-on experience writing unit, integration, system, and scale/performance tests, and building automation (pyATS/Genie or equivalent) integrated into CI/CD and regression pipelines. Solid understanding of IP networking and subscriber/broadband protocols: PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, RADIUS/AAA, PPP, L2TP. Working knowledge of Cisco Silicon One (SiOne) NPU-based User Plane Functions (UPFs) - data-plane/forwarding architecture, CP-to-UPF programming, and how subscriber sessions map to NPU forwarding. Cloud-native fundamentals: Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and service meshes. Experience building and consuming gRPC/REST APIs and data models (YANG, protobuf). Distributed-systems concepts: high availability, redundancy, state reconciliation, and scale. Strong Linux skills; experience with Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. AI-assisted engineering is a must: hands-on use of AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on with BNG/CUPS, CP-UP separation, SRG geo/warm redundancy, or 5G/BNG converged-core architectures. Experience with SMI (Subscriber Microservices Infrastructure) or similar cloud-native telco platforms. Familiarity with Silicon One platform families (Cisco 8000 / ASR 9000 / NCS) as User Planes. Scale/performance characterization and traffic/subscriber-simulation tools (IXIA/Spirent). Databases/caching for network state (SQL/NoSQL, key-value stores, etcd); AAA/policy, IPAM at scale, and QoS. Model-driven telemetry, NETCONF/RESTCONF/gNMI, OpenConfig; Aha/Jira API suites. Expectations The successful candidate will independently own a significant Control Plane feature area and its unit/integration/system/scale validation and automation, deliver production-quality code and tests, lead complex investigations across CP and Silicon One UPFs, and provide evidence-based release recommendations - while influencing design, mentoring, and using AI-assisted tools responsibly with security and engineering accountability. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: CAI India CAI India is a strategic investment in the company's future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust. The Role You will be the engineer who walks into a business problem, sees the application, dashboard or integration that solves it, and builds it end to end with AI as your first tool and a full stack of skills behind it. As CAI Discrete's single, self-sufficient builder, you will work with the leaders of Support, Professional Services, Sales, Marketing, Product and Engineering to find manual, repetitive or invisible work and replace it with something that runs on its own: an AI-driven workflow on Claude and tools such as Scribe, a purpose-built internal application, a live executive dashboard, or a data pipeline connecting the systems CAI runs on — NetSuite, Salesforce and Service Cloud, Gong, Mosaic, Aha!, Jira/Azure DevOps and GitHub. This is a hands-on build role; success means things you built are in daily use, manual hours are gone and leadership decides from dashboards you created. You start as the only dedicated AI Automation Engineer in the BU; your track record is what grows the team. What You Will Build and Do AI-driven automations: Claude-based agents and workflows that remove repetitive steps in Support and PS first, then Sales, Marketing, Product and Engineering — prompt and tool design, agentic flows, guardrails and evaluation. Internal applications: Small, purpose-built web applications where no off-the-shelf tool fits, built end to end — React or Angular front end, Python/C#/Node API, SQL database — secured with CAI's identity platform. Executive dashboards: Weekly-use dashboards for pipeline to revenue, market signals, customer health, engineering productivity and roadmap to shipped, with consistent KPI definitions and AI-generated narrative. Data connectivity for enterprise applications: Pipelines and connectors pulling enterprise-application data via APIs into a governed data layer with scheduled refresh and quality checks — internal business-system connectivity for analytics, not product integration. How you work: Scope the need with functional leaders, propose and align before building, ship with source control, CI/CD, tests and documentation, monitor in production, and quantify impact in hours saved, cycle time and adoption. What We Are Looking For 6+ years of software engineering with demonstrated full-stack delivery — applications you personally built across front end, API and database and supported in production. Hands-on experience building automations or applied AI workflows with Claude, ChatGPT or comparable LLM tooling; demonstrated build experience, not theoretical interest. Proficiency in a back-end language (Python, C#/.NET or Node.js/TypeScript), a modern front-end framework (React or Angular) and SQL, including data modeling and query tuning. Dashboards and data pipelines: Power BI, Tableau or a code-based stack; ETL/ELT design; API integration with SaaS business applications (OAuth 2.0, webhooks, incremental extraction) — ideally two or more of NetSuite, Salesforce/Service Cloud, Gong, Mosaic, Aha!, Jira/ADO, GitHub. Engineering fundamentals — Git, CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins), automated testing, Azure or AWS, secure handling of credentials and data. Business instinct to pick problems worth solving, clear written and spoken English with non-technical stakeholders, strong self-direction across concurrent projects, and regular overlap with US business hours. Role Parameters and Ownership Bangalore, India; minimum two days per week in office; no travel. Priorities and assignments from the GM, CAI Discrete Manufacturing; engineering standards and cross-BU practice with the Director of Engineering, Bangalore. High-ownership objectives: initial roadmap within 30 days with execution from month two; monthly status and quarterly outcome reports; hours saved as FTE-equivalent capacity is a standing measure. 3-6 Yrs Automation, Software testing, API Automation, Artificial Intelligence, API Testing, Automation engineering, Rest, Rest Assured
